name: seedance-prompts-mcp

tools.name: search_prompts
tools.description: Search 150 AI video prompts that were each actually rendered into a video with Seedance 2. Returns titles, categories and source links; use get_prompt for the full prompt text and the example video.

query.description: Free text, English or Japanese (e.g. "neon street", "product commercial").

needs_reference_image.description: true = only image-to-video prompts that expect a reference image.

tools.name: get_prompt
tools.description: Full English and Japanese text of one prompt, plus the example video URL that this exact prompt produced.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The ten prompt categories with how many prompts each one holds.

tools.name: check_prompt
tools.description: Audit a draft video prompt against the seven elements measured across the 150 rendered prompts (style, scene, subject, camera, lighting, sound, timeline). Returns what is missing, why it matters, and a real prompt to copy from.

tools.name: build_prompt
tools.description: Compose a structured video prompt from parts. Fills the seven elements into the bracket format the rendered prompts use, and flags the parts you left empty.

beats.description: Ordered beats, e.g. ["0-3s: the door opens"].

instructions: Search and audit AI video prompts that were each rendered into a real video with Seedance 2. Every result carries a source URL on emaki.ai with the example video.
